say: You earn well. So why could one bad year wipe you out?
caption: You earn well. So why could ONE bad year wipe you out?

say: Here are seven financial blind spots most Malaysians never see.
caption: 7 financial blind spots most Malaysians never see.

say: One. Your car is insured. Your house is insured. But your income? Not.
caption: Your car is insured. Your house is insured. But your income? Not.

say: Two. Your medical card has a limit. One week in I C U can use it all up.
caption: Your medical card has a limit. One week in ICU can use it all up.

say: Three. Your child's degree could cost a quarter of a million ringgit by age eighteen.
caption: Your child's degree could cost RM250,000 by age 18.

say: Four. Your savings earn zero point two five percent. Prices rise three point five percent. Your money is shrinking.
caption: Savings earn 0.25%. Prices rise 3.5%. Your money is shrinking.

say: Five. You know when you want to retire. But can you pay for it? E P F alone may not be enough.
caption: You know WHEN you want to retire. But can you pay for it?

say: Six. Own a business? If something happens to you, your family gets the loans, not the profits.
caption: Own a business? Your family could inherit the loans, not the profits.

say: Seven. No will? The law decides who gets your money, and your family can wait years.
caption: No will? The law decides who gets your money.

say: So, how many did you just recognise? Most people find at least three.
caption: How many did you recognise? Most people find at least 3.

say: The good news? Every gap can be closed, if you plan before it's needed.
caption: Every gap can be closed if you plan before it's needed.

say: Comment, guide, and I'll send you my free seven blind spots checklist.
caption: Comment "GUIDE" for my FREE 7 Blind Spots checklist
